findings.title: Exit code for recreate upgrade changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE moves from 4 to 3, and 4 is reassigned to FEATURE_DISABLED. Existing scripts that treat 4 as 'recreate needed' will now read it as 'feature disabled'. The Operator or other tooling that maps these codes also needs checking. The change is justified by the picocli codes but is a breaking contract change that should be called out.

findings.title: Feature-disabled path tested only for the metadata command
findings.body: The new feature check was added to both the metadata and check commands. The new test testFeatureNotEnabled covers only metadata. No test verifies that check prints the error and exits with code 4 when the feature is disabled. The exit code 4 is also not asserted for either command.

findings.title: Feature flag is appended after the user-supplied parameters
findings.body: The macro appends `--features=rolling-updates` to every rendered update-compatibility example. Users who copy the command and add their own `--features` list would end up with two `--features` options, so the examples can mislead users. The docs also never explain that the flag must be merged with the user's existing features.
